items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I was the one to talk to the lady to record because I was acquainted with them because I made a lot of recordings with Cuarteto Caney and Noro Morales.

ctx.x: And then I recorded with Noro, with everyone. I was free-lancing with everyone.
